sections.body: The life this archive documents, and the pipeline that turns his scanned papers into a searchable, cited knowledge base.

stages: people, places, conditions, favors, dates extracted
RiC-O temporal graph: entities + records + dates
hybrid BM25 + dense vectors; FTS; IIIF
tool-using agent answers with cited sources
sections.footnote: This is a developer & evaluation harness: you can swap the LLM, embedding space, and reranker, toggle retrieval techniques, and watch the agent's trace + cost for every question. Every answer cites the exact scanned region.
